WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill_size
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), first_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS avg_all_orders
  FROM per_order
), first_filtered AS (
  SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_fill_size, p.avg_fill_size - b.avg_all_orders AS margin_over_all
  FROM per_order p
  CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b
  WHERE p.avg_fill_size > b.avg_all_orders
), second_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS avg_first_filtered
  FROM first_filtered
), final_orders AS (
  SELECT f.avg_fill_size, f.margin_over_all,
         f.avg_fill_size - b.avg_first_filtered AS margin_over_first_filtered
  FROM first_filtered f
  CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b
  WHERE f.avg_fill_size > b.avg_first_filtered
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS avg_per_order_fill_size,
       AVG(margin_over_all) AS avg_margin_over_all_orders,
       AVG(margin_over_first_filtered) AS avg_margin_over_first_filtered
FROM final_orders
